Priya (CSM): Quick heads-up — we're doing an AtlasOps QBR soundcheck next Wed 10:00am PT. Plan: 15m exec readout, 20m deep-dive. Can owners confirm slides and who will cover renewal risks + enablement asks?
Liam (AM): I'll own the renewal risks slide. Will draft a 1-page risk summary by Tue EOD.
Zoe (Eng PM): I'll take the performance metrics slides (latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens). Need raw numbers from Marcos or the console.
Marcos (Solutions Eng): Sending perf snippets now. Snapshot: avg p99 gen latency 320ms, token cost $0.0027. Putting charts into the shared slide.
Priya (CSM): Awesome. Also need onboarding status: top 3 blockers across accounts and enablement gaps. Can Customer Success leads drop bullets here?
Marcos (Solutions Eng): Quick note — recommend adding fallback plan if model A spikes. Suggest slide: "Fallback routing & canary" with config snippet.
Priya (CSM): good call. Example snippet for the slide:
```
routing_policy:
  primary: rwd-model-v1
  fallback: rwd-model-qg-lite
  timeout_ms: 1200
```
Liam (AM): @Zoe — can you add a line on cost-saving via batching? I'll surface it to execs.
Zoe (Eng PM): Yep. Will add before Wed. Also need a callout for Dedicated capacity commits for high-volume customers.
Priya (CSM): Who's available for a 30m dry run Tue 3pm PT? Need to rehearse transitions and fallback demo.
Marcos (Solutions Eng): I can. Will prep a live demo of caching impact (~2x token savings on prefix-heavy flows).
Redwood Deploy Bot: calendar invite sent to: Priya, Liam, Zoe, Marcos — Tue 3:00pm PT
Priya (CSM): Thanks — small ask list before Tue:
- Liam: 1-pager renewal risk
- Zoe: perf + batching slides
- Marcos: live demo + slides
- All: one bullet of enablement ask from your pod
Please paste final bullets here by Mon noon so I can stitch slides. :thumbsup:
Liam (AM): On it.
Zoe (Eng PM): Will drop bullets by Mon 11am.
Marcos (Solutions Eng): Adding demo notes and enablement asks now.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. We'll keep the executive readout tight — 5 slides max. If anyone hits blockers ping me.
Liam (AM): quick Q — any change to audience? Exec + Platform + Sales? 
Priya (CSM): Exec + Head of Platform + Customer advocate. Keep language high-level for the 15m section.
Zoe (Eng PM): Noted. I'll create 2 versions of the perf slide: one for execs (top-line) and appendix (detailed charts).
Priya (CSM): perfect — that's the plan. :wave:
